messages:
Anya Patel: Oakridge RFI landed. They want: capability matrix CSV, short security answers, POC scope + 2-week eval plan, and Dedicated vs Hosted pricing. Need a single bundle by Tue EOD.

Luis Moreno: On it. Ill prepare a compact capability CSV snippet and a one-paragraph ops blurb. Warm-hosted standby recommended for low tail latency.

Devon (Ops): I can provision the sandbox. Need Oakridge engineer email + S3 bucket. CLI snippet for runbook: 
``
redwoodctl provision --org oakridge --env oakridge-poc --commit 3
redwoodctl upload --env oakridge-poc --source s3://oakridge/testdata
```

Kate (Finance): Pricing preview (draft): Dedicated commit (3x A100 equiv) $52k/mo; Hosted burst $0.0010/token; POC credit 60% for first 14 days. Will export formal sheet.

LegalBot: Uploaded: POC_Addendum_Template_Oakridge.docx. Note: DPA/BA required if PHI involved; can run scoped limited-POC with redacted data.

RFP Bot: Reminder: include capability_matrix_oakridge_{ts}.csv and Oakridge_RFI_Answers_{date}.zip in response bundle.

Anya Patel: Thanks all  please paste any short paragraphs or attachments here and I'll assemble the ZIP after finance/legal sign-off.
